correctness.rationale: For n>=5 the complement has diameter at most two; its general-position subsets correspond exactly to complete multipartite induced subgraphs of the deleted maximum-degree-two graph. Counting independent sets, K2, induced P3, K3 and C4 gives the polynomial without overlap. Negative real roots of independent-set polynomials of every path/cycle component yield Newton inequalities. The explicit n>=14 estimates prove strict LC at every modified index; the complete 1003-isomorphism-type exact certificate proves n=5..13. The embedded verifier also independently computes graph distances and enumerates all GP subsets for 175 types n=5..9. Exact output VERIFY_OK. Limits: no n<5, no degree>=3, finite checks alone not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Motivated by the general-position-polynomial literature and its unimodality problem, the theorem gives both every coefficient and strictly log-concave shape for all complements of arbitrary disjoint unions of paths and cycles, not one artificial finite slice. It isolates the exact low-degree perturbation of independence polynomials and controls the nonreal-rooted resulting polynomials by Newton slack, providing reusable structural reasoning. The result does not pretend to cover maximum degree three or higher.
